title: Maximize Total Tastiness of Purchased Fruits
summary: Given price and tastiness arrays of length n, and maxAmount and maxCoupons, select fruits to maximize total tastiness without exceeding maxAmount.
statement: Given price and tastiness arrays of length n, and maxAmount and maxCoupons, select fruits to maximize total tastiness without exceeding maxAmount. Use up to maxCoupons to buy fruits at half price (rounded down). Return the maximum total tastiness achievable, with each fruit purchased at most once and each coupon used at most once.
constraints: Each fruit may be bought at most once or skipped.
A coupon changes one chosen fruit’s price to floor(price/2), and at most max_coupons coupons may be used.
Keep total cost at most max_amount and maximize total tastiness.
hints: Maintain best tastiness by (money spent, coupons used).
For each fruit, copy skip states, then add full-price and discounted transitions when affordable.
Keep only the largest tastiness reaching each state.
Every fruit has exactly the three enumerated choices, so iterating them once explores all legal purchase sets without reuse.
editorial: Every fruit has exactly the three enumerated choices, so iterating them once explores all legal purchase sets without reuse.

tests.explanation: Buy the first fruit at full price and one twenty-price fruit with a coupon for cost twenty and tastiness thirteen.
Using a coupon on the first fruit costs two and yields tastiness six, better than buying the second fruit normally.
